categories.name: Visual hierarchy
categories.rationale: The board puts reminder text first, with quiet inline navigation and a separate composer. Flattened setup guidance and sign-in sections preserve a clear reading order; the full-board status remains visually too muted.

categories.name: Spacing/grid
categories.rationale: Consistent horizontal insets, first-line control alignment and full-width separators give long paragraphs a deliberate rhythm. Native grouped Account spacing works across both detents; the technical error banner is less refined.

categories.name: Typography scale
categories.rationale: System text styles, restrained weights and wrapping captions produce a coherent native scale. Large sign-in titles and compact board titles suit different tasks; no custom display treatment is needed for this utility.

categories.name: Dynamic Type
categories.rationale: Native default/XXXL boards, guide, sign-in and Account retain complete text and reachable controls. Capacity text now wraps intrinsically. XXXL is not an accessibility category, and larger native settings remain unverified.

categories.name: Light contrast
categories.rationale: Primary board content and active alternate actions are clear. The static default-size capacity message measures about 3.29:1 against its light composer fill, below a 4.5:1 normal-text target. Disabled fixture controls are excluded from this finding.

categories.name: Dark contrast
categories.rationale: Primary text, first-line circles, grips and neutral elevated surfaces remain legible against black. The sampled dark capacity label is substantially clearer than its light counterpart; arbitrary Activity wallpapers are not certified.

categories.name: Iconography
categories.rationale: Existing completion circles, account symbol, setup glyphs and six-dot grips are consistent and functional. Their first-line placement now connects controls to the correct reminder; no ornamental color or replacement icon is needed.

categories.name: Safe area / Dynamic Island
categories.rationale: Observed app states clear the status region; expanded native Island text and footer fit inside the pill. Compact/minimal emptiness is the existing intentional contract. Physical sensor and truly locked-device geometry remain outside this evidence.

categories.name: Scroll/pull-down / last row
categories.rationale: All four accepted bottom-after-pull captures show the complete final reminder above the composer. XXXL geometry places final text bottom around675.67pt and composer top679.67pt; native tests cover refresh settlement and bottom visibility.

categories.name: List rows
categories.rationale: Plain native collection rows retain complete paragraph height, separators and 44pt first-line controls. Reordering and accessible move actions exist. The repeated demo paragraphs are content stress fixtures, not a reason to penalize the layout.

categories.name: Empty states
categories.rationale: All Clear and the flat dismissible guide form a useful first-empty state. Every instruction remains present before/restored, while the focused state cleanly removes the guide; the Apple empty counterpart is quieter but has different semantics.

categories.name: Composer ergonomics
categories.rationale: The bottom field is reachable, grows to four lines, and keeps add/dismiss controls separate. Capacity is correctly represented as static wrapping text. The light status contrast and absence of a native long populated-draft capture limit the score.

categories.name: Keyboard handling
categories.rationale: Eight post-scroll native recheck states show separated Done and alternate actions. The strengthened suite and three dedicated matrices complete32 cases with independent edge taps and zero scoped invalid-frame events; normal interactive dismissal is handled.

categories.name: Sheet presentation/detents
categories.rationale: Native medium/large Account sheets retain clear Done controls and scrollable lower content at default/XXXL. No clipping blocks lower actions. References are reminder Details sheets rather than semantic Account equivalents.

categories.name: Navigation clarity
categories.rationale: Your Board, Account and Sign In remain clearly titled; modal dismissal and alternate sign-in paths are explicit. Native inline title collapse after scrolling is consistent with the supplied Apple compose references.

categories.name: Touch targets
categories.rationale: Source specifies44pt board controls, retry, sheet Done and fields, plus48pt sign-in Done/alternate controls. Passing native geometry and edge-tap checks support the important paths. This is not a complete enabled-production accessibility hit-region audit.

categories.name: Haptics
categories.rationale: Success/error sensory feedback and drag-start selection feedback are wired in source. Physical intensity, timing and consistency cannot be judged from simulator stills or test pass counts; this category remains provisional.

categories.name: Animation/transitions
categories.rationale: Board changes use a short0.2s transition and explicit Reduce Motion guards. Native Activity endpoint frames are tidy. Focus/sheet/list continuity and reloadData animation quality were not watched in a reviewer interaction session.

categories.name: Loading states
categories.rationale: Native initial loading and sign-in progress retain stable layout; retry/submission guards and named progress are present in source. Actual network wait duration and delayed completion behavior remain unobserved.

categories.name: Error states
categories.rationale: Initial and populated failures are visible, wrap at XXXL and retain local recovery/dismissal. Board/auth announcement policies are explicit. The exposed NSURLErrorDomain string is technical, and account failure announcement remains source-only risk.

categories.name: VoiceOver/labels
categories.rationale: Explicit labels, row state, reorder positions/actions, success announcements and new deduplicated board/auth error policies are sound. Account failures still rely on updatesFrequently/haptics; spoken announcements, traversal and focus preservation were not observed.

categories.name: iOS HIG consistency
categories.rationale: System navigation, native collection rows, keyboards, grouped lists and sheet detents give the app an Apple-native foundation without copying Reminders layout. The muted static status treatment and technical error presentation are remaining polish issues.

categories.name: Lock Screen / Live Activity
categories.rationale: Eight native Activity surfaces preserve visible-plus-hidden totals through the actual production payload pipeline: banner5+5/default and4+6/XXXL; Island3+7 and2+8. Intentional tail ellipsis is not hidden-count loss. True lock, wallpapers and lifecycle remain unverified.

categories.name: Sign-in/onboarding
categories.rationale: Unboxed provider/email sections, wrapped inbox/error variants and a dedicated Done inset are clear. Local demo editing/recovery is exercised while external actions remain blocked. Enabled provider appearance and successful live authentication are not certified.

categories.name: Settings/account
categories.rationale: Account status, grouped actions, lower footer and confirmations are coherent at both sizes/detents. Existing operational guidance is dense but readable. Demo-disabled rows do not establish production contrast; account error presentation needs accessibility follow-up.

categories.name: Performance feel
categories.rationale: Native virtualization and duplicate-operation guards are sensible; the completed scheme reaches idle and scoped layout diagnostics are clean. No frame-time, launch-time or real perceived response measurements were provided or run by this reviewer.

categories.name: Delight
categories.rationale: Quiet surfaces, precise first-line controls, complete capacity copy and a clean focused empty state make the utility feel considered. Muted full-board status, technical errors and unobserved tactile/motion quality keep it short of exceptional delight.

categories.name: Long text
categories.rationale: Long native paragraphs, final-row text, capacity wrapping, Account footers and auth messages survive XXXL. Activity overflow is structured and correctly recomposed. Native largest accessibility sizes and a long typed draft remain gaps.

categories.name: Reduced Motion / Transparency
categories.rationale: Source removes explicit board/tip motion under Reduce Motion and supplies solid error/composer alternatives for reduced transparency/increased contrast. Native setting toggles, Activity system material adaptation and full interaction coverage are unobserved.

categories.name: Palette / minimalism
categories.rationale: Flat board/guide/sign-in surfaces, monochrome rows and restrained native tint meet the minimal direction. No nested decorative cards or added red/orange palette is present; existing red only communicates genuine errors.

findings.evidence: The exact static Board full — combine lines instead status is now complete, but at default light it visually reads as a disabled field. Original1206x2622 raster sample x90..900,y2300..2450 contains5620 solid glyph pixels RGB(133,133,139) against RGB(242,242,247), yielding3.287:1. Source composer uses body text with foregroundStyle(.secondary) on secondarySystemBackground, and this Text is static rather than a disabled control. This finding excludes the intentionally disabled add arrow, sign-in providers and Account demo actions.
findings.fix: Keep every word, icon, intrinsic wrapping height and neutral palette. Give the static capacity label a stronger neutral foreground, preferably the existing primary style or an adaptive neutral meeting4.5:1 for normal body text. Keep the add button disabled. Recheck the separate hint without reducing type size.
findings.basis: observed native raster and source-derived styling; measured contrast at default light, not a claim about every appearance
findings.check: Add a native raster contrast regression for static capacity text at default/XXXL in light/dark and increased contrast. Require>=4.5:1 for normal text and preserve full exact string, capacityIdeal height,44pt targets and final-row clearance. Use solid glyph/background samples rather than antialias-edge minima. Run the complete existing iOS suite after the change.

findings.screen: Account failure after Sign Out/Delete Account; context: extras/account-dark-XXXL-large-lower.png; source ios/App/AccountView.swift and ios/App/BoardPersistenceSection.swift
findings.evidence: AccountView inserts its error section near the top and supplies updatesFrequently plus error sensory feedback, but does not post an error announcement or apply an accessibility focus policy. Delete failures can arrive after the user worked near the lower end of a long sheet. Board and sign-in now have explicit deduplicated announcement policies, so the previous risk remains specifically on Account. BoardPersistenceSection also reports refresh failure by inserting result text. The provided Account screenshots contain no failure, and no spoken VoiceOver session establishes an actual missed announcement.
findings.fix: Apply a deduplicated announcement policy to new Account errors and refresh results, using the exact existing message strings. Preserve editing/reading context and avoid moving focus away from local recovery. Keep all section names, wording and icons unchanged.
findings.confidence: medium-high for source gap; user impact unobserved
findings.basis: source-derived conditional accessibility risk; not an observed VoiceOver failure
findings.check: Add policy tests for first error, repeated identical visible error, clear/re-present and changed error. Add safe local failure fixtures for Account sign-out/delete/refresh without service calls. With VoiceOver enabled verify the existing message is spoken once, is reachable after failure, and focus remains predictable after retry/dismissal; run the complete existing iOS suite. Automated policy tests alone cannot certify speech.

findings.evidence: The native error description exposes The operation couldn’t be completed. (NSURLErrorDomain error -1009.). It wraps without clipping, but platform/domain syntax takes substantial space, especially in the populated top banner. Source propagates error.localizedDescription into failedBoard and BoardErrorBanner. Try Again and cached reminders remain available, so this is presentation/recovery clarity rather than data loss. No exact Apple failure fixture exists.
findings.fix: Preserve the complete existing error string and existing title/action/icon. Separate the technical parenthetical into subordinate diagnostic typography or existing expandable detail treatment, while keeping Couldn’t Load Board and Try Again visually primary where those existing controls apply. Do not invent replacement copy or add decorative cards/colors.
findings.confidence: high for observed presentation; medium for proposed hierarchy improvement
findings.basis: observed native screenshots plus source-derived propagation
findings.check: Capture default/XXXL light/dark initial and populated errors with the same exact string. Assert complete diagnostic text remains reachable, recovery/dismiss targets remain>=44pt, and populated reminders still scroll to the last row above the composer. Retain existing error-announcement deduplication and run the complete existing iOS suite.

evidence_gaps: All110 inventoried native images were reviewed through nine historical contact sheets plus the eight-case recheck sheet; meaningful original-resolution samples included all four accepted board bottoms, board tops/control alignment, both-appearance XXXL guide before/focused/restored, composer, all eight post-scroll keyboards, sign-in inbox/error/loading/password, Account detents/top/lower and native Activity banner/Island. Contact sheets are derived inspection aids and are not additional native captures.

The110 native images comprise98 app simulator states,8 visible native Activity surfaces and4 intentionally empty compact/minimal states. Twelve app-rendered unit Activity rasters are excluded. Rejected transition/short-scroll captures were not used.

All17 usable paired Apple Reminders references were inspected at original resolution, including eight new matching XXXL top/bottom/compose/Details references. Notes is unavailable. Dark empty, guide, loading/error, authentication, Account-vs-Details and Activity-vs-list comparisons have semantic gaps; exact per-state mappings and type mismatches are disclosed in pairings.json/md.

True physical Lock Screen, hardware sensor geometry, arbitrary wallpapers, always-on presentation and authenticated Activity start/update/renewal lifecycle are unverified. Notification Center is native evidence, not true locked-device certification. Compact/minimal Island emptiness is intentional and is not graded as missing copy.

Physical haptics, spoken VoiceOver/traversal/focus after list reloads or sheet failures, and reviewer-observed animation/performance timing remain unverified. Stills, source and test outcomes do not certify them; those category scores remain provisional.

Native XXXL means extraExtraExtraLarge, not the largest accessibility category. Native accessibility sizes, Bold Text, Increase Contrast and actual Reduce Motion/Transparency interaction matrices are absent. Unit-rendered accessibility Activity checks cannot substitute for native coverage.

External authentication/providers/legal links and most Account controls are deliberately disabled in safe demo captures. Their dimming is not an enabled-production contrast defect. No live authentication, account deletion, sign-out service operation, notification prompt or backend request was performed by this reviewer.

Native populated long-draft editing, enabled provider appearance, Account error/progress fixtures and Home Screen/accessory widget views are not supplied. Source was inspected for these relevant behaviors; no success is inferred from source alone.

The historical275/1 baseline remains failed.
